title: EOS UX/design record (G-UX)
description: Whether this product has a user-facing surface, and — when it does — that the interaction contract is actually covered. A non-UI product records a structured SKIP with a reason; it can never simply omit the answer.

userInterface.description: Does a human interact with this product directly (GUI, CLI, chat, voice)? An API consumed only by other services is false.

skipReason.description: Required when userInterface is false. 'SKIP' on its own is not a decision.

coverage.description: Required when userInterface is true. Each dimension names WHERE it is specified, so the claim points at something a reviewer can open.

ref.description: Document + section where it is specified.
